title: RO 劍士：清晰中性設計圖與 API 重建第三階段
brief: 用Blender無法修好的動作(因為需要修的幅度太大)，改用先產生圖片、Hyper3D建模、Blender修細節；不限制現有點數，按建模需求測試API；commit、push等使用者驗證。
purpose: 獨立可編輯角色與可搬移GLB，驗證固定基準、有界修訂、真實美術／骨架／連段及匯出驗收。

style.description: 照片中的年輕棕髮男性動漫劍士，銀灰裝甲、深藍衣襬、白色前襟及棕色皮裝；依二維參考重建三維。
must_have: 棕色尖髮與動漫男性臉
深藍分叉衣擺與白前襟
可編輯骨架及真正連續技能動作
可關閉的斬擊、怒爆火焰、霸體金色光效
must_not_have: 把場景文字或火光融合進角色幾何
靜態圖片輪播代替骨骼動畫
以特效遮住握持或關節缺陷
自行新增遊戲傷害／碰撞規則

spec.size_scope: GLB [X,Y,Z]: character nominal standing height1.74m (+Y up); X/Z are planning envelope only. Weapon and animated envelope measured separately; no claim exact XYZ size.
spec.triangle_budget_scope: 完整角色與劍合計上限；展示stage/VFX另記。

animation_contract.root_motion: 原地表演；跳躍由骨盆位移，不改遊戲位移；動作銜接推定。

parts.pivot: 骨盆左右分叉衣擺獨立活動
分離展示層，角色動作可不含效果檢查

production.reason: User-directed reconstruction after major source-pose fusion and joint rebuilding. Clear empty-hand A-pose design separates arms/torso/weapon; new raw baseline, same six quality targets. Prior failures and consumption preserved.

additional_checks.description: 乾淨場景GLB重匯入，實際skin/joints/channels/材質/採樣與變形保留；以交付hash綁定。
斬擊／怒爆／霸體效果對應參考且可關閉；無效果全段另外檢查。

assumptions: 背面及中間動作依照片設計推定；不是原作測量還原。
來源容器5秒60fps；精確節奏及不可見姿態為重建。
不包含臉部台詞或自動重定向；骨架命名映射與使用說明交付。
參考權利由使用者提供，商業使用權仍未驗證。
One initial image-to-3D job at adapter fixed0.5 credits. Latest user permits existing monthly/regular credits and all available APIs as needed; no top-up/upgrade.
Clear frontal A-pose does not prove hidden surfaces, separate fingers, skin topology or automatic rig/animation; inspect actual result before local work.
One local refinement candidate in this new phase, after complete raw baseline; do not reset old phase budget.

protocol.lighting: Fixed Eevee studio: Key (3,-4,5)700W 4m; Fill(-3,-2,3)350W 3m; Rim(0,3,4)800W 3m; world(.16,.16,.16). No VFX on evaluation views.
protocol.background: AgX exposure0; neutral grey floor(.18,.19,.21); 1280x1280 PNG.
protocol.tool_version: Blender4.5.5 LTS build836beaaf597a; BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT; local reproducible construction.
protocol.inspection_context: Standalone stylized humanoid matching supplied art. Compare five views and face; inspect neutral animation entire300frames and transition midpoints; shoulders/elbows/hips/knees, grip, sword arc, foot contact, garment collision; clean GLB reimport. No target game specified.

original_phase.old_result: invalid experiment and failed deformation, preserved without reset
original_phase.new_scope: three bounded local reconstruction revisions after a reviewed new source baseline

phase_history.status: Final third candidate under independent review. Preserved, no remaining fourth local candidate. New user-directed API route changes source; does not erase prior trials.
